prompt: 我有一个客服 Agent，用 Claude Sonnet 做后端。上线后用户反馈说 Agent 经常编造不存在的产品功能（幻觉），而且在多轮对话中会忘记前面聊过的内容。帮我设计一个评估方案来量化这些问题。

assertions.description: Defines hallucination rate as an evaluation dimension with scoring criteria
Defines multi-turn coherence as an evaluation dimension
Uses multiple runs per test case (3-5) with statistical aggregation, not single pass/fail
Uses behavioral property verification (e.g., 'does not invent features') not exact string matching
Provides a structured test case format with input/expected behavior/assertions
Includes an evaluation report template with scores and failure analysis
